title: Separate current transport from narrow retention and common supply
statement: Each private reservoir feeds a short wide useful bridge through a narrow side neck outside the useful current path. A common metallic feed instead joins independently requested pairs into one net. Introduced bridge bulk .848826mohm plus two .020ohm contacts gives .040848826ohm per edge; the narrow neck in series would add .01061033ohm. Actual private layout, two reliable contacts, insulating common pressure head, positive return, wetting and two stable states are unsupplied.

Thermal bridges carry their particular electrical topology and capacitance.
